result.stdout:
USAGE:
    pomkit [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help        Prints help information                                   
    -v, --version     Prints version information                                
        --global      Use the global store (~/.pomkit) instead of the nearest   
                      local one                                                 
        --no-color    Disable colours. The NO_COLOR environment variable is also
                      respected                                                 
        --verbose     Show stack traces for errors                              

COMMANDS:
    init           Create a pomkit store here, or in ~/.pomkit with --global
    interactive    Guided menus instead of typed commands                   
    scan           Map pages in a browser with the Pomkit panel             
    map            Print a project's page map                               
    add            Add a project, environment or pattern                    
    remove         Remove a project, environment or pattern                 
    list           List projects or patterns

    pomkit add project <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Project name, e.g. Acme

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
        --global               Use the global store (~/.pomkit) instead of the  
                               nearest local one                                
        --no-color             Disable colours. The NO_COLOR environment        
                               variable is also respected                       
        --verbose              Show stack traces for errors                     
        --env <ENV>            First environment name, e.g. dev                 
        --url <URL>            Base URL of that environment                     
        --pattern <PATTERN>    POM pattern (default: component-based)
